items.title: Jack DeJohnette — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: No, not to a gig but my uncle was proud of me. But we jump ahead. I went to high school. I went to, where did I go? I had some situations in school where I… …which school did I graduate from after grammar school? Oh, I can't remember that. But I do remember where I went to high school. I went to CVS, Chicago Vocational School, which was very interesting. At that time I was singing doo-wops. I had a quartet and at the time we'd sing at the battle of the doo wop bands. I used to sing lead and second

tenor. At that time there were groups around like The Diablos and The Cadillacs and The Wrens, and you know, Frankie Lymon and the Teenagers. The Ravens and James Brown, “Please! Please! Please!” had come out around that time I think.
Well, you had several black record labels there too, Vee Jay records…
